    <bpmn:task id="quick" name="Do the first quick scoring (level 1)" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="immediate" name="Result immediately available?" />
    <bpmn:task id="returnr" name="Return the result to the banking system" />
    <bpmn:task id="inform" name="Inform the banking process of the delay" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="split" />
    <bpmn:task id="display" name="Display the delay message to the clerk" />
    <bpmn:task id="level2" name="Do the level 2 scoring" />
    <bpmn:task id="sendback" name="Send the result to the banking process" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="join" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="merge" />
    <bpmn:task id="present" name="Present the result to the clerk" />
    <bpmn:task id="see" name="See the result at the frontend" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="receive" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" sourceRef="returnr" targetRef="merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" sourceRef="inform" targetRef="split" />
